asked.item: Setting or approval to post to the Facebook group automatically
Posting to the group instead of the Page

verdict.reason: The pages say Blotato cannot publish to Facebook Groups because Facebook's API doesn't allow it, which answers the question.

steps.text: Blotato can't post to Facebook Groups, because it publishes to Facebook Pages only.
Facebook's API does not let third-party tools post to Facebook Groups.
Blotato can only publish to a Facebook Page, so that is where your posts can go.
